faqs.q: Is Reyna a good agent for beginners in Valorant?
faqs.a: Reyna is easy to understand, which makes her popular with new players, but she is only as strong as your aim. Her abilities depend on getting kills and she offers little utility to help teammates, so beginners who are still learning to win gunfights may find her frustrating and could learn more from agents with team utility.

faqs.q: Why do so many players pick Reyna in ranked games?
faqs.a: Reyna rewards individual skill. Each kill lets her heal or escape, and her ultimate lets a confident player chain fights together, so a good aimer can carry a round almost alone. That self-sufficiency appeals in ranked matches with strangers, where teamwork is not guaranteed.

faqs.q: How do you counter Reyna in Valorant?
faqs.a: Avoid giving her isolated one-on-one fights. Peek together so any kill she gets can be traded straight away, use flashes and other utility before engaging, and pressure her early in the round before her ultimate is ready. A Reyna who cannot get kills has very few tools left to influence the game.

faqs.q: Has Reyna been nerfed in Valorant?
faqs.a: Yes, Riot Games has adjusted Reyna several times since her release, including changes to the cost and charges of her abilities, her healing and her ultimate. Agent balance changes regularly, so check the latest official patch notes for her current numbers.
